
# Template Catalog

Ohtli defines a standard template for each core domain entity.

| Template  | Purpose                              |
| --------- | ------------------------------------ |
| Project   | Documents a temporary initiative.    |
| Area      | Documents an ongoing responsibility. |
| Knowledge | Captures reusable knowledge.         |
| Journal   | Records chronological events.        |
| Review    | Documents periodic evaluations.      |
| Inbox     | Captures unprocessed information.    |

## Future Templates

Additional templates may be introduced for specialized use cases.

Examples include:

* Meeting
* Decision
* Reference
* Book
* Article
* Research Note

New templates should reuse the existing metadata model and follow the template guidelines.
